My verdict for an average player

  1. Your main team is Anteiku, and you're one unit away from October's top Anteiku teams. Both are Maid Toka · Owl of Readiness · June Bride Toka · Hinami (one runs Hina Matsuri Hinami, the other Halloween Hinami). With Halloween Hinami, you own three of the four at 6★.
  2. If you spend on one Carnival unit, make it Yoshimura [Owl of Readiness]. He's in every October Anteiku meta team. He's already rated A at 0★, so one copy is enough, and 4+ creators recommend him.
  3. Legacy tickets go to Hinami [Hina Matsuri]. She's the cheapest real upgrade, an Anteiku regular from April to October, and in October's #2 team.
  4. Don't chase Ken [√A] or Akira [June Bride]. Ken is in 0 October teams. Akira is the most-used back-up, but she's gone (the chain pack ended and there's no shop). Use your Roma [Mad Clown] 6★ as back-up; creators run her too.
  5. Why not CCG, even though it scores #1 overall? You own 4 of 5 in October's CCG #1, but Juzo, Haise and Ginshi are all 0★. Creators' copies are starred up. Your Anteiku and No Org units are 6★, so for you they'll hit much harder.
  6. Second team: No Organization. You own 4 of 5 in October's No Org #1 (all 6★). Only Uta [The Past] is missing, and he's a Carnival unit, so wait on him until after Owl of Readiness.

Spending plan: most power per gem

1 · Free / already yours

  • Field Maid Toka + June Bride Toka + Halloween Hinami plus Flame Strike (1★) or 1st Anniv Toka (2★), with Roma [Mad Clown] as back-up.
  • Your No Org team (Nutcracker, Sen, Seaside Rize, Valentine Rize, Roma BU) is already 6★ across the board.
  • Put level-ups and cells into the Anteiku core first; that's the team you'll keep.

2 · Legacy tickets (cheap)

  • Hinami [Hina Matsuri], the first pick.
  • Then Toka [1st Anniversary] copies for stars (2★ now).
  • Before you pull, check the Legacy pull button accepts your ticket type. If it does, a guarantee lands at 200 pulls.

3 · Diamonds / money (expensive)

  • Only one Carnival unit at a time: Owl of Readiness.
  • Carnival guarantee = 300 pulls ≈ 90,000 diamonds. Switch the featured unit only at 0 pity.
  • After him, Uta [The Past] finishes No Org.
  • Skip: Ken [√A] (out of the meta), and anything that only shows up in one creator's team.

Why Yoshimura [Owl of Readiness] over everyone else

  • The data: he's in both October Anteiku meta teams, and he's the unit that pushed Flame Strike and √A out of the #1 team.
  • He doesn't need stars to work. The guide rates him A at 0★, S at full stars. Most Carnival units need copies to come online; he works from one copy.
  • His kit makes your whole team tankier and hit harder: +15% DEF at battle start, [Grudge] stores 30% of damage taken and adds it back as extra damage, +4% DEF/Block per Outrage stack (up to 16%), and 8% heals. At 3★, +18% all stats to all allies. He also auto-casts his actives at 70%, 50% and 30% HP.
  • Creators: "recommended" by 4+ creators (M confidence), "A" and "A with cell" (MirageYT).
  • Counterpoints, to be fair: Shi rated him "meh", and TheKenKaneki called him "the most replaceable" in his team. He's strongest in this exact Anteiku team, which is also the team you own.

UnitWhy not first

The Ken [√A] question: why a 2★ Ken one-shot your team

  • Gaze: every Active Skill your side uses gives him a stack. At 3 stacks he strips all your shields and hits everyone for 200% ATK. That's the 5M AoE on your turn.
  • Oblivion: +6% crit rate for every 2% HP he's missing. Chipping him makes his next AoE hit harder.
  • Active: 440% (+60% ATK), +50% damage and a stun against Weak targets. That's the 1.4–1.5M single hit.
  • At 2★ he has the +12% all-ally stats; he does not have the 3★ AoE when he dies.

How you beat him (with what you own)

  • Don't chip him. Hit him only on a turn you can kill him, or kill his teammates first.
  • Count your actives: every 3rd one triggers his AoE.
  • Per-hit caps: Maid Toka (no more than 45% max HP per hit above 50% HP, and she counters actives); Seaside Rize (No Org: 40% cap).
  • Immortal + 1-HP save: Flame Strike + Halloween Hinami. That's exactly what kept you alive.
  • Shields don't help; he strips them all.
  • Cells that break immortality or block his skill: unknown, not in my data yet. I won't guess.
Was he going to wreck a normal team? Mostly yes. Without a death-save or a damage cap, every 3rd active costs you a unit. He's strong in PvP spikes, but he's out of the creator meta.

Month by month (Dec 2025 – Oct 2026)

MonthWhat changed in the top teams
Dec 20251st-Anniversary units (Ken and Toka [1st Anniversary]) plus Hideyoshi run Anteiku. Aogiri = Noro + Naki.
Jan 2026Toka [New Year] joins Anteiku. No Org runs Christmas Rize + Uta [The Past]. Hideyoshi is in every faction.
Feb 2026Carnival Ayato [Wings of Ardor] arrives and goes straight into Aogiri.
Mar 2026Carnival Toka [Flame Strike] arrives and Anteiku is built around her.
Apr 2026Ken [√A] arrives. Flame Strike + Ken [√A] + Hina Matsuri Hinami + Hideyoshi = "the strongest team in the game".
May 2026Anteiku keeps the Flame Strike + Ken [√A] core. Aogiri adds Tatara [Easter] + Ayato [1.5th]. Haise [Mentor] starts CCG.
Jun 2026CCG becomes playable: Arima + Haise [Mentor] + Haise [Sealed Memory] + Urie, Mutsuki in back-up.
Jul 2026June Bride Toka + Akira [June Bride] (back-up) arrive. No Org = Orochi + Seaside Rize.
Aug 2026Akira [June Bride] is the back-up in nearly every team. Aogiri adds Yakumo [Natsu Matsuri]. No Org adds Sen.
Sep 2026CCG gets Juzo [False Girl] + Shirazu. No Org gets Nutcracker. Anteiku gets Maid Toka + Yoshimura [Readiness].
Oct 2026Aogiri gets Ayato [Black Rabbit] + Miza. No Org swaps Orochi for Uta [The Past]. Halloween Hinami + Yoshimura [Readiness] push Flame Strike out of the top Anteiku team.

How I ranked (so you can check me)

  • Team score (0–100) = 40% popularity + 30% recency + 30% creator tier.
  • Popularity: how often the team's 5 units show up across all Jul–Oct top teams.
  • Recency: Oct = 100, Sep = 75, Aug = 50, Jul = 25. The meta moves every month.
  • Creator tier: the guide's tier for each unit (S = 3, A = 2, B = 1), averaged.
  • What this is not: a battle simulation of your account, or the whole player base. It's 9 creators' actual team screens, read against game portraits. "Shop ~day 75" listings are unconfirmed.
  • Your roster: stars come from your Red Thread profile (owner-confirmed).
Sources: Red Thread meta_timeline.json (creator team screens, 2026-11-07), coach.json (game skill text + kb/claims.jsonl creator claims), historical_banners.json (Legacy pool), your yukiteru profile. Generated Nov 8, 2026.
